name: founder-kit
description: Plugins for bootstrapping founders — a founder coach to start with, project setup, customer research, compliance, agent delivery into cloud sandboxes, and smart site delivery for non-coding founders.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Project setup for Founder Kit: set up a new project with a baseline for working with Claude Code agents, or check an existing project against the current baseline and fill the gaps.

plugins.name: compliance
plugins.description: Online safety, GDPR, application security and Supabase data access compliance for platform builders. Covers UK OSA, EU DSA, UK/EU GDPR, Children's Code, COPPA, OWASP, and whether a Supabase app's row-level security protects its customers' data.

plugins.name: agent-delivery
plugins.description: Dispatch a planned ticket into a Claude cloud sandbox, run its tests against a disposable Supabase preview branch, and get back a pull request with the ticket closed out.

plugins.name: site-delivery
plugins.description: Smart non-coding founder toolkit for delivering website changes through a thin brief-to-PR path with optional tracker integration and compound-engineering stages.

plugins.name: customer-research
plugins.description: Customer research for bootstrapping founders: turn real customer conversations and public evidence into an ideal customer profile, personas and a competitor view you can use to validate an idea and sell it, and fact-check the claims you make and meet.

plugins.name: founder-coach
plugins.description: A coach for bootstrapping founders: works out where you are on the journey from idea to first revenue and beyond, what done looks like for that stage, what to do next and which tool helps, and keeps your founder profile and progress between sessions.
